fusions.name: Grumbled Hex
fusions.desc: Mutters a hex that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 35% chance of leaving the target [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Commanding Roar
fusions.desc: Roars a cone of force that deals 14 damage to everything caught in it and stuns it for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance of leaving the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Reserves
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds and restores 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Primed Word
fusions.desc: Each time your mana becomes full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 20 seconds.
